create_EsViTTrainer: create an EsViTTrainer for self-supervised vision transformer training with teacher-student architecture
build_NetWrapper: build a NetWrapper to intercept hidden layer outputs from a ViT backbone and pipe them into projector and predictor nets
build_MLP: build an MLP projector or predictor network with configurable layers, hidden size, and L2 normalization
test_view_loss_fn: test the view_loss_fn for computing cross-entropy between teacher and student view-level logits with centering
test_region_loss_fn: test the region_loss_fn for computing region-level loss using similarity-matched teacher and student spatial tokens
